2608.19831.title: Causal Reasoning with Bipartite Graphical Causal Models
2608.19831.paper_summary: Causal Bayesian networks (CBNs) and structural causal models (SCMs) are the dominant frameworks for graphical causal reasoning, but they cannot adequately represent all real-world causal systems. In particular, systems at equilibrium---where feedback mechanisms create cyclic causal dependencies---can exhibit causal semantics that are fundamentally incompatible with these frameworks: different interventions that enforce the same variable value may have different effects, rendering the standard ``perfect intervention'' do($X = x$) ambiguous. We propose bipartite graphical causal models (BGCMs), in which the structure of a system of equations is encoded by a bipartite graph with variable and equation nodes. In this framework, a hard intervention do($f_j : X_v = ξ_v$) specifies which equation is replaced, which variable is targeted, and at what value---resolving the ambiguity of the standard notion. We demonstrate, through a detailed case study of a physical system, that this representation naturally corresponds to distinct real-world interventions. We formulate a Markov property in terms of a new graphical separation criterion (B-separation) that exploits the functional determinism inherent in the equations, and we extend it to settings with non-random inputs. We show how this gives rise to a do-calculus for reasoning about domain invariances. BGCMs strictly generalize CBNs and SCMs while retaining the ability to perform graphical causal reasoning.
2608.19831.paper_summary_zh: 因果貝葉斯網絡（CBNs）和結構因果模型（SCMs）是圖形因果推理的主要框架，但它們無法充分表示所有現實世界的因果系統。<lb/>特別是，處於平衡狀態的系統——其中反饋機制產生循環因果依賴——可能會表現出與這些框架根本不相容的因果語義：強制相同變量值的不同干預可能會產生不同的效果，使得標準的「完美干預」do($X = x$) 變得模糊不清。<lb/>我們提出了雙部圖形因果模型（BGCMs），在這種模型中，方程系統的結構由一個包含變量和方程節點的雙部圖來編碼。<lb/>在這個框架中，硬性干預 do($f_j : X_v = ξ_v$) 指定了替換哪個方程、針對哪個變量以及在什麼值下進行干預——解決了標準概念的模糊性。<lb/>我們通過對一個物理系統的詳細案例研究，展示了這種表示自然地對應於不同的現實世界干預。<lb/>我們以一種新的圖形分離標準（B-分離）來表述馬爾可夫性質，該標準利用了方程中固有的功能決定性，並將其擴展到具有非隨機輸入的情境。<lb/>我們展示了這如何產生一種用於推理領域不變性的 do-calculus。<lb/>BGCMs 嚴格地概括了 CBNs 和 SCMs，同時保留了進行圖形因果推理的能力。
